title: Upward Sun River infant reveals 'Ancient Beringians'
place: Upward Sun River site, Alaska, United States
summary: The genome of an infant buried about 11,500 years ago in Alaska revealed a lost population, the Ancient Beringians, who split from other Native American ancestors about 22,000-18,100 years ago.
why: Supports the idea of a long pause in Beringia before people moved south.
